project.title: Berlin wall relief with complete water openings and S/U transit accent

process.printer: Anycubic Kobra 3 Max Combo with one ACE Pro

coordinate_frame.origin: lower-left corner of the 600 x 400 mm artwork on the rear datum plane
coordinate_frame.transform_convention: row-major 4x4 matrix maps source coordinates to project millimetres

requirements.statement: Every retained mapped water area and river/canal/stream shall be a through-opening, except for an explicitly logged topology bridge needed to keep printed land connected.
requirements.source: approved concept v07 and user continuation on 2026-09-04
requirements.verification: source-to-mask accounting, Tegeler See regression and connected-component audit

requirements.statement: Oak owns the base, Mint Green the middle relief, Midnight every street class including motorway/trunk, and Sky Blue S-Bahn/U-Bahn plus context boundary and site marker.
requirements.verification: four-body ownership audit and exact target-slicer tool report

requirements.statement: Each 300 x 400 mm half shall remain one connected printable body and be independently supported at the wall; no rear grid or blanket rib network is allowed.
requirements.verification: candidate comparison, topology audit, placement audit and physical handling/proof test

requirements.statement: Lighting remains an optional unsupplied add-on and the digital phase shall not upload or start a print.

global_style.summary: Abstract four-color Berlin map with light-through water and readable transit accents
global_style.detail_hierarchy: outer mode and water voids first, streets second, S/U transit and site marker third

assembly_sequence: Print and qualify the existing connector/interface coupon on the selected process.
Print the left and right four-body halves rear datum down.
Insert three one-way connectors and press the halves together once on a flat fixture.
Install one upper support per half plus lower standoffs; do not use the center seam as the gravity load path.
Optionally add customer lighting only inside the declared rear envelope.

decision_log.topic: Approve water, transit, topology-bridge and four-color ownership.
decision_log.current_basis: The user approved concept v07 and the targeted bridge strategy before asking the design work to continue.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Retain the approval trace in design-spec.yaml and decomposition-review-0.5.3.md.

decision_log.topic: Freeze same-date Berlin and Brandenburg extracts and bounded semantic derivatives.
decision_log.current_basis: Official 2026-08-30 Berlin and Brandenburg PBFs were reacquired; derivative extraction and coverage evidence are pending.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Record transport hashes, derived-layer hashes, projected coverage, counts and Tegeler See relation 451908.

decision_log.topic: Select the least-material viable aperture reinforcement candidate.
decision_log.current_basis: Candidate B uses only mandatory 2.0 mm full-thickness topology bridges. Local rear ribs are conditional and currently disfavored because they conflict with rear-datum-down printing and halo lands.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Compare openings-only, topology-bridged and conditional local-rib candidates; then perform a physical handling and installed proof test.

decision_log.topic: Qualify final connector clearance, opacity, purge and wall-load behavior.
decision_log.current_basis: Prior digital geometry and exact Anycubic slicing exist, but no exact four-spool physical coupon or wall proof test exists.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Process-matched connector/light/color coupons and mass-based installed proof test.

components.name: Frozen Berlin-Brandenburg semantic source set
components.role: owns immutable boundary, roads, water areas, water lines and S/U route relations

manufacturing.orientation: EPSG:25833 to one global panel frame

components.name: Two independently mounted four-color relief halves per display mode
components.role: owns backer, outer masks, seam split, sockets, four positive color bodies and print datum

manufacturing.method: four disjoint named FDM solids per half
manufacturing.color_body: Oak, Mint Green, Midnight, Sky Blue

components.name: All-water cutter and mandatory topology bridge authority
components.role: owns through-part negative water geometry, protected keep-outs and the minimum bridge set needed to prevent detached land

manufacturing.method: negative mask plus full-thickness local bridge restoration
manufacturing.material: none; restored bridges inherit Oak base

nominal_geometry.type: single global map transform and four semantic body masks

requirements.load_or_flow: visual relief only; base carries handling and wall loads

nominal_geometry.type: water polygon and buffered water-line union

requirements.load_or_flow: optional light passes through; every retained source component must be accounted

nominal_geometry.type: through-cut mask with conditional full-thickness 2.0 mm topology bridges

joining.method: subtract aperture then restore minimum connectivity bridges

requirements.load_or_flow: one connected printed body per half; each half independently hung

keepouts.purpose: center seam and connector protection proxy
union planning proxy for local hanger and standoff lands; exact bodies remain mode-specific
parameterized site-marker and attribution protection proxy

validation.method: validate plan and review unique ownership
validation.acceptance: no plan errors; water, bridge and four-color responsibilities have one owner

validation.method: compare openings-only, topology-bridge and conditional-rib masks
validation.acceptance: select the least-material candidate that leaves one connected backer per half and respects keep-outs

validation.method: source coverage, feature accounting, Tegeler See regression and mesh audit
validation.acceptance: all required layers are non-empty, every water feature is accounted and every exported body is manifold

validation.method: interface, open-area, ligament, body-overlap and seam-continuity reports
validation.acceptance: no unintended collision, no detached land, no tool-4 motorway layer and open area does not exceed 12 percent per half

validation.method: vendor-aware 3MF checks and exact slice-anycubic-next runs
validation.acceptance: four aligned non-empty tools produce non-empty G-code within resource budgets

validation.method: process-matched connector/light coupon, handling test and installed mass-based proof test
validation.acceptance: no crack, detached land, unacceptable flex, disengagement or permanent set; lighting remains optional
